displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Bryant 288BNV Evolution heat pump or 189BNV air conditioner. A short flash is 0.25 seconds on and a long flash is 1.0 second on. Code 33 is 3 short and 3 long
meaning: Lost inverter communications, the local fault. It occurs after 2 minutes with no communication between the outdoor control and the inverter, and it elevates to fault 48 after 3 consecutive failures within 20 minutes or after 20 minutes of continuous loss.
causes: The service manual points code 33 at the fault 48 checks
Loose or disconnected harness between outdoor-control plug PL20 and the inverter
diySteps: Count 3 short flashes and 3 long flashes. Do not open the outdoor cabinet to reseat a harness
Technician: check the harness between PL20 and the inverter. For noise, the manual says the system tries repeated starts. If the inverter is damaged, change the inverter drive
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. This cabinet carries line voltage. Furnace code 33 is a limit fault and does not apply here.
sourceTitle: Bryant 288BNV heat pump / 189BNV air conditioner service manual (SM288BNV-189BNV-04)
